facts.conclusion: BusinessConfiguration excludes BimFaceConfig and registers the active SDK bean using offline credentials and fixed legacy endpoints; engine credentials alone do not enable the active bean.
The excluded historical config reads engine.appKey and engine.appSecret and sets fixed legacy endpoints; SDK network timeouts were one hour.
The service reads engine.projectId. Upload sends projectId as both parent/project ID and streams the attachment URL; translate and integrate call the SDK.

Translation callback is GET /api/model/3DModel/translate/status/callback?modelId&token. Integration callback is GET /api/model/3DModel/integrate/status/callback?modelId&areaIds&userId&token. URLs concatenate chum.config.url, so the configured base must provide the required separator. Callback handlers compare the Redis token and requery SDK status.
Migration has a separate fixed legacy file-copy endpoint plus fixed project/parent identifiers; it is a destructive identity-changing path and is not part of preparation or a test.

BIM conversion quota reads DB config code BIM_MODEL_CONVERT_RESTRICT_ENCIPHER and TOTAL_QUANTITY/FILE_SIZE statistics. A hardcoded AES key literal exists in checkBimModel; its value is deliberately omitted.

Browser loader has fixed historical external API/resource/static hosts, dev host, and portal loader URL; SDK version is 3.6.295. These are historical private deployment targets and are not reproduced here.

Actual viewer imports initBimfaceApp from the loader module. CSP and opt-in host policy must cover SDK script, model resources and connections; backend-only preparation cannot establish browser readiness.

approved_minimum_preparation.endpoint_policy: Use SDK defaults unless an explicit endpoint override is supplied. Disabled mode retains the current offline bean. Enabled mode refuses missing credential values. No credentials in reports.

facts.conclusion: BoChuNesting already reads LJAPS_BOCHU_APP_ID and LJAPS_BOCHU_SECRET; HTTP signature is lowercase MD5(appId + newline + secret + newline + local yyyyMMddHHmmss timestamp). Headers are X-FS-Appid, X-FS-Time, X-FS-Token, X-FS-Orgcode and X-FS-Encode.

Actual scheduling and WMS business methods duplicate signing and hardcode X-FS-Appid literals despite using the environment AppId in the signature. This can produce mismatched signatures for a different authorized app.

Some legacy scheduling methods contain fixed Orgcode account literals; no safe new tenant mapping can be inferred. Preserve their exact original expressions and block those paths until on-site confirmation.

NestingUtils contains two private duplicate HTTP methods; a full main-source reference scan found no external reference to the class or its private methods. It is not evidence of an enabled entry point.
WMS material/plate APIs use ConfigProperties.boChuUrl (chum.config.boChuUrl) while other methods hardcode cloudnest.fscut.com. A configurable WMS base URL therefore does not redirect all BoChu calls.

NestWebSocketRunner is excluded with all rest.runner classes by active BusinessConfiguration. It would read nesting teams with boolDrillHole=1 and open outgoing WS subscriptions using teamCode and a companyUrl hash. Do not enable it implicitly.

WmsWebSocketClient decodes payload base64, acknowledges messageId and routes stock events to WmsNestMaterialService. This is an outgoing WS consumer, not an HTTP callback route. Historical transport is ws:// on the public vendor host.
The active controller selects sendToNestingV3 or sendToNestingModeTwo from the existing nesting task config; protocol and database effects depend on that business mode.
